header.shortDesc: Orthodontic treatment brings unique challenges, from cleaning around braces and aligners to preventing cavities and decalcification. SuperMouth’s orthodontist-designed orthodontic systems are specifically crafted to address these challenges, with products tailored for orthodontic care, including OrthoBrushes (manual and sonic), OrthoFloss with built-in threaders, and uniquely formulated toothpastes and mouthwashes. Each product works together to ensure teeth and gums are protected, clean, and strong during this critical time. Choose the system that best fits your needs: the Basic System offers minimum recommended orthodontic care, the Plus System adds enhanced cleaning and protection for braces and aligners, and the Complete System delivers the ultimate whole-mouth care for orthodontic treatment.

left.title: Whole-Mouth Satisfaction Guaranteed
left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.

tiers.superText: The Complete System offers the highest level of care for those with orthodontic appliances, delivering full-mouth protection that combines cavity prevention, enamel strengthening, advanced gum support, microbiome balance, and bad breath control. Powered by fluoride and Hydroxamin® (nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 & K2), this system is specially designed to protect teeth from decalcification and cavities during treatment. It’s ideal for those who want complete care, ensuring that every aspect of oral health, including fresh breath, is addressed throughout orthodontic treatment.

items.q: Why is it important to use a specialized orthodontic system during orthodontic treatment?
items.a: Orthodontic treatment requires unique oral care to maintain optimal hygiene around braces, aligners, or other orthodontic devices. Our orthodontic system is specifically designed by leading orthodontists to meet these needs, ensuring that your teeth stay healthy and clean throughout treatment. With products tailored to tackle the challenges of orthodontic care, you can prevent common issues like cavities and decalcifications while achieving the best possible results from your treatment. Additionally, purchasing our orthodontic system ensures you receive the best pricing and access to valuable educational content designed to guide you through this stage of your oral health journey.

items.q: What makes SuperMouth’s orthodontic products revolutionary?
items.a: Our orthodontic system features groundbreaking technologies that set it apart from standard oral care products. For example, our patented SuperBristles Ortho on the OrthoBrush manual brushes clean teeth up to an incredible 40X better than standard manual brushes. When used with our Ultim8 SmartBrush System, these bristles deliver an astonishing 60X better clean. These bristles were developed after scanning thousands of people with braces, making them perfect for patients with braces, aligners, or other orthodontic devices. This truly revolutionary design ensures your teeth get the best possible care during orthodontic treatment.

items.q: How long does a System last?
items.a: Each System is designed to last 90 days — 3 full months — for the average user. Subscriptions deliver a fresh box every 90 days, with monthly or quarterly payment options, and you can adjust your delivery schedule anytime if your family uses more or less.

items.q: How do your orthodontic floss products improve oral hygiene during treatment?
items.a: Our OrthoFloss collection is designed to make flossing with braces and other orthodontic devices easier and more effective. Each floss comes with built-in threaders for easy cleaning around brackets and wires, and the thicker, expanding floss ensures thorough cleaning between teeth and around orthodontic appliances. This comprehensive approach helps prevent plaque buildup 40% better than standard flosses, keeping your gums healthy throughout your orthodontic journey.

items.q: What makes your orthodontic toothpaste and mouthwash different from regular products?
items.a: Our toothpaste and mouthwash are specifically formulated with Hydroxamin+ and fluoride to provide enhanced protection against cavities and decalcifications—permanent yellow or brown marks that can occur after orthodontic treatment, whether you’re wearing braces, aligners, or other orthodontic devices. These ingredients work together to strengthen enamel, protect against decay, and keep your teeth looking their best during and after orthodontic care.

items.q: How can I transition from the orthodontic system to a regular oral care routine after treatment?
items.a: Switching from our orthodontic system to one of our age-appropriate systems post-orthodontics is seamless. Our products are designed to support your oral health at every stage, so once your treatment is complete, you can easily transition to a system that maintains the results you’ve achieved and continues to protect your teeth and gums.
